analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation scrap between 17th and 14th. ADO sacked Robin Peter on 2 November and beat Sparta 3-1 under interim Levi Schwiebbe; Voetbal International reports Maurice Steijn is set to return as coach. Utrecht are sinking, with Anthony Correia pointing to set pieces and the defence after conceding seven in two games.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals. Both defences are poor (ADO conceded 25 in 12, Utrecht seven in two games), but the stakes usually make these games tense, so I keep the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. I lean higher: ADO scored from a corner against Sparta and Utrecht's set-piece defending is a known weakness, so ADO have every reason to force corners.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. I lean higher: two clubs near the bottom, a coach under pressure in Correia and a home crowd that will push ADO on.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.6 shots. I lean lower: two struggling teams in a must-not-lose game usually play with caution, and neither attack has been prolific.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. For the same reasons, I expect fewer clean chances than the estimate.
